findings.assertion: Support for democratic governance at UANL helped bring student groups back into public street protest after the October 1968 repression; this movement was not solely a local Mexico City dispute.
findings.limitations: This is the perspective of the editors and institutional retrospectives; original student assembly materials were not inspected.

findings.assertion: A June 10 surveillance transcript records protest preparations at the Escuela Nacional de Ciencias Biológicas, including placards being sorted by school around 16:05; the recorded time is a state-agent report, not an independent stopwatch.
findings.source_locator: INEHRM 2021 edited IPS report pp.99–100, web text lines 1903–1915
findings.limitations: Agent estimates and reported clock times require corroboration from independent witnesses.

findings.assertion: An edited security report places a dispersal attempt using tear gas shortly after 17:10 and the appearance of Halcones at approximately 17:15 along Alzate and Sor Juana Inés de la Cruz.
geographies: Avenida de los Maestros / San Cosme
findings.source_locator: INEHRM 2021 edited IPS chronological report pp.101–103, extracted lines 1970–1999
findings.limitations: Security-document chronology is not independently validated; agents' characterizations may minimize responsibility.

findings.assertion: An edited Dirección Federal de Seguridad report states police and Halcones were already deployed on Nogal, Instituto Técnico Industrial/San Cosme, Nonoalco and Buenavista between noon and 15:00.
findings.source_locator: INEHRM 2021 pp.118–119, DFS report, AGN DFS Caja AC 146/4223 Exp. 11-4 L.132 fs.363–367; web text lines 2380–2401
findings.limitations: Source is an official surveillance account; figures at posts are assertions from that report, not independently measured totals.

findings.assertion: Government versions initially denied the existence of Halcones, while contemporary reports and a later UNAM photographic exhibition document paramilitary attacks. These evidence types should be compared as competing public narratives.
findings.source_locator: INEHRM 2021 introduction p.11 cites El Día 11 June and AGN Caja 971 Exp.1 ff.182–184; UNAM 2021 lines 15–29
findings.limitations: A contemporaneous public denial is evidence of an official statement, not evidence the group did not exist.

findings.assertion: At the Casco de Santo Tomás, an official surveillance report locates early afternoon student concentrations near Ciencias Biológicas and Carpio, providing a historically documented starting district for a possible interpretive walk.
findings.source_locator: INEHRM pp.99–101, IPS timestamps 16:05–17:05; Gaceta UNAM 2020 route summary
findings.limitations: Current campus access, building survival and exact starting point require field verification.

findings.assertion: The junctions along Avenida de los Maestros, Amado Nervo and San Cosme appear in contemporaneous security reports describing attempts to halt the march; a safe field stop should explain evidence bias instead of recreating an unverified exact route.
geographies: Avenida de los Maestros / Amado Nervo
findings.source_locator: INEHRM pp.101–103, 17:10–17:30 entries; Gaceta UNAM 2020 route overview
findings.limitations: Different route intentions are described in the sources; modern walking route not geospatially validated.

findings.assertion: The Cine Cosmos frontage is mentioned in security reporting as a location near police vehicles and armed confrontation; a later INEHRM account describes residents sheltering students when businesses closed.
findings.source_locator: INEHRM pp.102–103 and INEHRM contemporary online overview 2021 (https://www.inehrm.gob.mx/es/inehrm/Mexico_Contemporaneo)
findings.limitations: Cine Cosmos building access and the shelter narrative require independent oral histories and current site verification.

findings.assertion: The Hospital Rubén Leñero became a documented medical and refuge site in contemporary reports; an Excélsior account republished in the anthology describes injured students seeking shelter and armed men entering hospital spaces.
themes: Medical care, witness testimony and repression
findings.source_locator: INEHRM 2021 pp.198–200, republished Excélsior 12 June 1971, web text lines 3563–3590
findings.limitations: Original newspaper page and hospital records not inspected; do not publish individual victim lists without checking.

findings.assertion: The original DFS report has a precise AGN archival locator in the anthology (Fondo SEGOB, Sección DFS, Caja AC 146/4223, expediente 11-4, legajo 132, folios 363–367), enabling a future direct manuscript/facsimile source audit.
geographies: Archivo General de la Nación / Mexico City
findings.source_locator: INEHRM 2021 p.119 footnote 39, web extracted line 2401
findings.limitations: Edited transcription only. Original AGN folios not inspected and textual fidelity not independently verified.

findings.assertion: UNAM's 2021 exhibition describes over 160 historical photographs grouped by press, independent photographers and intelligence services; the photographs should be attributed and interpreted as different evidence-producing contexts.
themes: Photography, visual evidence and archive rights
geographies: San Cosme / CCU Tlatelolco memory collections
